issues.description: patch_description values use full sentences (e.g. 'Replace config.guess with OHOS-capable version (E007 fix)') instead of the recommended '{序号} {description}' format (e.g. '0001 replace config.guess with OHOS version'). The rule example shows patch_description should start with the 4-digit patch number.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider prefixing each patch_description with the patch number, e.g. '0001 Replace config.guess with OHOS-capable version (E007 fix)'. This is a non-blocking style recommendation.

issues.description: patch_classification entries have guard: 'pending' for all three patches, indicating the platform-guard analysis (whether the patch is guarded by #ifdef __OHOS__ or unconditional) has not been completed. This is informational and does not affect build correctness.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update guard field to 'unconditional' or 'ifdef __OHOS__' once the analysis is complete. Non-blocking.

issues.description: import os is only referenced in a commented-out alternative code path (line 33). The import is technically unused in the active code. Very minor style issue.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either remove the unused import or uncomment the alternative test approach. Non-blocking.
